description:
If \(w\leq u\), \(w\leq v\), \(u
leq v\), and \(v
leq u\) in a nonempty preordered frame, the specified two-upset model makes \(u\Vdash p_0\), \(u
Vdash p_1\), \(v\Vdash p_1\), and \(v
Vdash p_0\). At \(w\), neither \(p_0	o p_1\) nor \(p_1	o p_0\) is forced, and \(w
Vdash\mathsf L(p_0,p_1)\).
